page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, no margin notes. Running head at top centre: JOH. MORINUS. Page number 548 at top left. No catchword or signature.

main_text.p: rant quindecim[?] præcipui, qui libros sacro non modo recensuerunt, secundum dictiones & litteras, ut priores, sed etiam neqvis in illis legendis erratet, puncta, inve-nerunt & textui inscripserunt, ut lectio quæ hactenus fuerat πατροπαράδοτος[?], scripto conservaretur; deinde libros illos publicè exposuerunt, ut Judæi libros suos ad eorum formam scriberent & corrige-rent; cùm autem viderent, paucos homi-nes eorum opera uti posse, eo qvòd pau-ci Judæi Palæstinam sese conferre possent, eorum libros inspecturi & eum suis com-paraturi, aliud opus ingens aggressi sunt, libros scilicet continentes; hæc dictio to-ties cum Patach, his scilicet locis qvæ per initia versuũ designarunt; toties cum Sæ-gol, &c toties reperitur in Scriptura cum hac voce conjuncta, &c. hi libri dicti sunt Masoretici, atqve ab eo tempore Masora sumi cœpit pro libro ista complectente, qvod ante fuerat inauditum; existima-rem tamen, priores Masorethas libellos aliqvos ejusmodi ad dictiones & literas spectantes in Judæorum gratiam com-posuis-

page.notes: Long s is written as plain s throughout. Hyphen at the line end of "posuis-" kept as printed. "qvin'decim" in the first line is uncertain: the apostrophe-like mark may be a printing spot. "πατροπαράδοτος" is read from a small scan and should be checked against the original. "Sæ-gol" and "&c. hi" and "inScriptura" are copied as printed.
